name: How do you file a personal injury lawsuit in California?

mainEntity.name: How do you file a personal injury lawsuit in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Filing a personal injury lawsuit in California requires submitting a complaint to the local Superior Court within the statute of limitations, collecting evidence, and negotiating with insurers or defendants before trial.
